exercises.instructionEn: Complete the sentences with the colours.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ro'yxatda 4 ta rang bor va har biri BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.
Shuning uchun bittasini noto'g'ri qo'ysangiz, boshqasi ham buziladi.

Usul: avval ANIQ bilganingizni qo'ying (tuxum — oq, daraxt — yashil),
keyin qolgan ikkitasi o'z-o'zidan joyiga tushadi.

DIQQAT: 'A lemon is yellow' — limon SARIQ. Yashil limon 'a lime' deyiladi,
bu boshqa meva.

commonMistake.whyUz: Qo'lyozmada 'green' yozilgan — XATO. Limon SARIQ (yellow). Yashil rangdagi o'xshash meva — 'a lime', bu boshqa so'z.
Qo'lyozmada 'yellow' yozilgan — XATO. Pingvin QORA va oq (black and white). 'yellow' allaqachon limonga ketishi kerak edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Label the parts of the body with words from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Tana qismlarini ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
8 ta so'z, 8 ta joy — har biri bir marta ishlatiladi.

QOIDASIZ KO'PLIK — bu yerda ikkitasi bor:
  foot → FEET  (oyoq → oyoqlar)
  tooth → teeth (Unit 2 ning oldingi betida)

Qolganlari oddiy -s oladi:
  head → heads · hand → hands · arm → arms · leg → legs
  finger → fingers · toe → toes · chest → chests

DIQQAT: 'finger' — QO'L barmog'i, 'toe' — OYOQ barmog'i.
O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham 'barmoq', inglizchada esa BOSHQA so'z.

commonMistake.whyUz: Qo'lyozmada 'nail' (tirnoq) yozilgan — XATO. Birinchidan, 'nail' RO'YXATDA YO'Q. Ikkinchidan, strelka barmoqni ko'rsatyapti. To'g'risi: TOE (oyoq barmog'i).

exercises.instructionEn: Now close your books, point to the parts of your body and name them.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi kitobni yoping, tanangizning qismlarini ko'rsatib nomlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu — ESLAB QOLISH mashqi. Ko'rsatib aytish so'zni tezroq yodda saqlaydi,
chunki harakat va so'z birga bog'lanadi.

Tartib bilan ayting (yuqoridan pastga):
  head → chest → arm → hand → finger → leg → foot → toe

exercises.instructionEn: Read the following and colour the people's eyes and hair.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagilarni o'qing va odamlarning ko'zi va sochini bo'yang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har gapda IKKI ma'lumot bor: ko'z rangi va soch tavsifi.

SOCH TAVSIFI TARTIBI (buzilmas):
  UZUNLIK + SHAKL + RANG + hair
  'short grey curly hair' — hmm, bu yerda: short (uzunlik) + grey (rang) + curly (shakl)

Aslida kitobda ikki xil tartib uchraydi. Eng keng tarqalgani:
  uzunlik → shakl → rang
  'long straight fair hair'
Lekin rang va shakl o'rni ba'zan almashadi — ikkalasi ham qabul qilinadi.

questions.en: What colour eyes and hair has Ann got?
questions.uz: Annning ko'zi va sochi qanday rangda?
questions.answerEn: She's got blue eyes and short grey curly hair.
questions.answerUz: Uning ko'k ko'zi va kalta kulrang jingalak sochi bor.

questions.en: What colour eyes and hair has Jean got?
questions.uz: Jeanning ko'zi va sochi qanday rangda?
questions.answerEn: She's got green eyes and long red hair.
questions.answerUz: Uning yashil ko'zi va uzun qizg'ish sochi bor.

questions.en: What colour eyes and hair has George got?
questions.uz: Georgening ko'zi va sochi qanday rangda?
questions.answerEn: He's got brown eyes and short black hair.
questions.answerUz: Uning jigarrang ko'zi va kalta qora sochi bor.

questions.en: What colour eyes and hair has Eric got?
questions.uz: Ericning ko'zi va sochi qanday rangda?
questions.answerEn: He's got dark brown eyes and light brown straight hair.
questions.answerUz: Uning to'q jigarrang ko'zi va och jigarrang tekis sochi bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures above. In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Yuqoridagi rasmlarga qarang. Juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI XIL SAVOL — ikkalasini ham yodlang:

  'What COLOUR eyes has X got?'  → RANG so'raladi
     Javob: 'He's got dark brown eyes.'

  'What SORT of hair has X got?' → TUR/TAVSIF so'raladi
     Javob: 'He's got light brown straight hair.'

'sort' o'rniga 'kind' ham bo'ladi: 'What kind of hair...?'
DIQQAT: so'roqda 'has X got' tartibi — 'X has got' emas.

wordFormation.introUz: Tana qismlarining ko'pligi va rang so'zlari.

groups.explanationUz: Tana qismlarining ba'zilari -s olmaydi. Ular eng ko'p ishlatiladigan so'zlar, shuning uchun yodlash shart.
Bu farqlar o'zbek o'quvchilari uchun eng ko'p xato manbai.
Rangning och yoki to'qligini bildirish uchun oldiga so'z qo'yiladi.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Rang va tavsif so'rashning ikki qolipi.

patterns.exampleEn: A lemon is yellow. / A penguin is black and white.
patterns.exampleUz: Limon sariq. / Pingvin qora va oq.
patterns.explanationUz: Rang aytishda 'be' ishlatiladi. Ikki rang bo'lsa 'and' bilan bog'lanadi.

patterns.formula: What COLOUR + NARSA + has + EGA + got?
patterns.exampleEn: What colour eyes has Eric got? — He's got dark brown eyes.
patterns.exampleUz: Ericning ko'zi qanday rangda? — Uning to'q jigarrang ko'zi bor.
patterns.explanationUz: RANG so'ralganda 'What colour'. So'roqda 'has Eric got' tartibi.

patterns.formula: What SORT of + NARSA + has + EGA + got?
patterns.exampleEn: What sort of hair has he got? — He's got light brown straight hair.
patterns.exampleUz: Uning sochi qanday? — Uning och jigarrang tekis sochi bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
TUR yoki TAVSIF so'ralganda 'What sort of' (yoki 'What kind of').
Javobda uzunlik, shakl va rang birga aytiladi.

patterns.formula: EGA + has got + KO'Z + and + SOCH
patterns.exampleEn: Ann has got blue eyes and short grey curly hair.
patterns.exampleUz: Annning ko'k ko'zi va kalta kulrang jingalak sochi bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ikki xususiyat bitta gapda 'and' bilan birlashtiriladi — bu tabiiyroq,
ikkita alohida gapdan ko'ra.
